lede: Oklahoma carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.6 against +5.8, a 4.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Oklahoma −1.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Oklahoma winning 54% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where South Carolina leads Oklahoma by 92 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 85% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
